fell: The same pattern holds across every recorded turn old enough to carry cache fields. 51 of 111 turns under .tofu/sessions carry usable cache accounting (the other 60 predate cache accounting or hold no steps, see the skip counts below); of those, 24 had at least one cache-write step, and 23 of those 24 ran a second model call and so read the write back at least once. Over the 24 turns with a cache write, the cohort billed 103777 fresh input tokens, 675237 cache-write tokens and 5700621 cache-read tokens: 88.0% of everything billed across this whole sample was a cache read.

The one case where deferring would pay is a turn that makes exactly one model call and never returns for a second, which was 1 of 24 turns in this sample: too rare and too cheap a miss to build a mechanism for.
